# General rules for handing in assignments 


1. You have to hand in all assignments except for one ungraded assignment.

1. Upload your assignments to ilias until Wednesday 3 pm. 

1. Assignments are *not* graded, unless it says so in the beginning of the assignment. 

1. You have to complete all numbered tasks; if there are one or more bonus tasks, you may skip them 


**This assignment will be graded** 



# Task 1: Estimate paramters with MCMC sampling 


* Take simulated data from a linear model one of the first assignments
    + Show the data

* Estimate the slope of a simple linear model with MCMC sampling (feel free to assume an intercept of 0 or estimate both)

* Check the results with a simple linear model using `lm()` and try to fit the model with the `brm()` function in the `brms` package 

* Illustrate the posterior distributions of the parameters. Describe what they tell you.
